description: The bar chart compares the performance gain (+%) of three different models—GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL—under two supervision conditions: Strong Supervision (represented by dark blue bars with diagonal stripes) and Weak Supervision (represented by light blue bars). The vertical axis, labeled "Performance Gain (+%)", ranges from 0 to 30, with major gridlines at intervals of 5. The horizontal axis lists the three models. For GPT-4o, the performance gain under Strong Supervision is approximately 24.5%, while under Weak Supervision it is about 5.5%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the gain is around 9.5% under Strong Supervision and 3.5% under Weak Supervision. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the gain is approximately 15% under Strong Supervision and 5.5% under Weak Supervision. In all three cases, the performance gain is significantly higher under Strong Supervision compared to Weak Supervision.
